messages:
olivia: Quick design review: retention presets on the Backup settings page — two quick nits I noticed before the next deploy: keyboard/tab focus order for the radio presets feels off for keyboard users, and the key badge that reads 'Managed' is ambiguous (do users think we have access to the key?). Screenshot attached. Can we decide on small copy + tab-order changes? sam: I saw this during the usability pass. Current tab order is: radio -> details link -> Save -> KMS pill. For screenreader/keyboard users the KMS pill should logically come right after the radio so it reads as part of the choice. Also the pill copy 'Managed' is terse — proposing 'Redwood-managed' vs 'Customer-managed (BYOK)'. Thoughts? :thinking_face: kevin: Technically swapping DOM order is easy (flex reflow + reorder). We'll need to update CSS but doable. Also we should include the KMS status in the radio's accessible name so SR users hear it together. Proposed aria-label example: aria-label="Retention: 30 days, Redwood-managed key". maria: @kevin yes please. A few a11y things: the radio group should have role="radiogroup" and aria-labelledby pointing to the heading. The details link currently has tabindex=-1 on the svg which makes it invisible to keyboard users — remove that. Suggested snippet: ```
``` Also prefer the KMS pill be focusable via tabindex=0 and referenced with aria-describedby for the tooltip (not role="button"). ben: On the wording: in security reviews customers interpreted 'Managed' as us having access to key material. We should avoid that ambiguity. Short pill = 'Redwood-managed' is clearer, but we also need a tooltip that explains whether we have access or not. Suggest tooltip copy: "Redwood-managed: key material is hosted by Redwood. Choose Customer-managed (BYOK) if you control key material." I'll coordinate with legal on the exact phrasing. olivia: Action list: (1) @sam propose two microcopy options (short & verbose) for the pill + tooltip; (2) @kevin reorder DOM so KMS pill appears after radio, add aria-labels; (3) @maria test keyboard flow and confirm tab order/contrast; (4) @ben coordinate legal on tooltip wording. Target: small patch for this week's release. @sam can you drop options here? sam: Dropping options now. Short: "Redwood-managed" / "Customer-managed (BYOK)". Verbose: "Redwood-managed (hosted key — Redwood manages key material)"; "Customer-managed (BYOK — you manage key material)". Also propose adding a small info icon with aria-label="Key management details" that opens the tooltip on focus. kevin: I'll do the DOM reorder and add aria-labels. Quick question — do we want the pill to be role="button" and interactive, or a focusable info node with aria-describedby? Role=button implies an action (opens modal), but this is just explanatory. @maria? maria: Prefer a plain focusable element (tabindex=0) + aria-describedby to point at tooltip content. Using role="button" suggests action and will confuse SR users. Also ensure the pill text contrast passes 4.5:1 for small text. ben: Legal/security: short label "Redwood-managed" is fine to start. Tooltip should explicitly say whether Redwood has access — I'll get final wording by EOD. sam: Uploaded quick mock: https://img.redwood/example.png — layout fits with the pill on the left of the details link. olivia: Great. :thumbsup: Kevin, please ping this thread when you open the PR. Maria, can you QC on staging before we merge? I'll queue Ben for final copy sign-off. kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4523 — includes DOM reorder + aria-label updates + unit test for radiogroup focus order. maria: I'll run keyboard regression on staging once the PR is deployed to the preview app and confirm the tab order. olivia: Thanks team — closing this thread once Maria confirms.
